risks.risk: The keyboard may not be a genuine Mm6 model, or may be a different model with different features.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name on the front panel or back panel, or a photo of the serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Yamaha keyboard, not as an Mm6, which may be worth less.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not have pitch bend functionality.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the pitch bend wheel being used to bend notes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a keyboard without pitch bend, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have internal damage or non-working keys/buttons.
risks.proof: A video clip showing all keys being pressed and all buttons being operated.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing accessories (e.g., power adapter, stand, or manuals).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the lid or on the bottom.
A clear photo of the model name on the front or back panel.
A video clip showing all keys being pressed and buttons being operated.
A video clip showing the pitch bend wheel being used.
A photo of the serial number or any model-specific label.
A photo of all included accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
